contents.text: {"answer":"Yes. Recalls 24V868000 and 24V204000 cover certain 2022–2024 IONIQ 5 vehicles for ICCU damage that can stop charging the auxiliary battery and result in loss of drive power. That is potentially related to the owner's reported ICCU failure, but the complaint does not establish the same underlying failure mechanism.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2022-2024 IONIQ 5"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2022-2024 IONIQ 5"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-Volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11778792","quote":"ICCU failed without any notification."}]}
